principles.status: Feature definitions/crosswalk considered; no positive implementation from a principle mapping alone.

scope_choices: Automated model review, not independent human verification or replication. Current synthesis received all extracted text and earlier automated page-image notes, not image pixels.

All twenty page texts and corresponding supplied image-review notes were considered, including figures, tables, appendices, contributors, and references. Earlier chunk-local missing-page statements do not mean pages are missing from this combined package.
Source hash/path/page count were supplied, not recomputed. Repositories, checkpoint files, licenses, split manifests, cited originals, and physical systems were not accessed.

All 128 catalogue feature IDs have dispositions. Teacher and decoder variants retain targeted additional scopes, not fabricated complete separate implementations. No executable schema, cross-reference, quotation-occurrence, coverage, or graph validation was run.
Quantitative validation is preclinical tabletop dVRK activity. Real video/hardware does not establish R2 actual human/clinical validation; input interfaces alone do not establish R4 or R6.
The 12 held-out episodes apply to simulation-quality metrics, not policy or runtime denominators. Entire-dataset training language and holdout construction remain unresolved, not proven leakage.

L2 is supported for the identified two-step TAEHV quality configuration. L4 is restricted to the runtime model's external-controller simulator coupling; its exact checkpoint/decoder/steps are not pinned.
Runtime policy-success agreement is not recoded as a successor-fidelity experiment. L4 does not establish separate L1/L2/L3 tests, model-based lookahead, or imagined-policy training.

No same-origin alternative-action comparison or identified surgical intervention effect is established. Causal attention/rectified-flow time/denoising steps must not be confused with identification or clinical time.
Distillation worsens all Table 2 fidelity endpoints. Hallucinated thread geometry and negative handover/knot-tie correlations limit utility despite positive pooled agreement.
Classifier validity, policy trial denominators, pooling, baseline rerun status, and the meaning of MMRV ± are insufficiently reported. Predecessor data/protocol reuse is dependent evidence.
No uncertainty decomposition, calibration acceptance, action-support guarantee, abstention policy, or tolerance-defined effective horizon is established.

Figure 4's stated contiguous five-second windows and approximately three-second marker spacing described in earlier image notes need reconciliation. No visual estimates were promoted to exact metric values.

Table 1 reports 74 ms while Table 4 reports 74.7 ms. Reported FPS/latency values are preserved without recalculation. Critical-path generation excludes stages and is not complete action-to-photon latency.
Separate downstream latency changes of 98.4 to 82.1 ms, factor 1.20, approximately 10× lower bandwidth, and 25% faster encoding are author-reported measurements, not full end-to-end latency.
Appendix A calls 544 × 960 nominal 540p and reports CPU encoding fallback. Higher-resolution fidelity and policy agreement are not established.
Action units/reference frames, constraints, support, and complete conversion semantics are insufficient for a validated interoperable action contract.
Perceptual/video metrics and the physics-simulation title do not prove biomechanical correctness, conservation, or physical causal fidelity.
Clinical-procedure validation, synthetic-to-real policy-training benefit, human training effectiveness, intraoperative support, and Cosmos 3 adaptation remain future work.
Header date and arXiv-margin date differ by one day; both are preserved. Release dates and exact artifact revisions are not inferred from either date.
Scoped reconstruction dispositions now identify separate modules/objectives, avoiding a false conflict between Phase 2 loss absence and unreported inherited autoencoder objectives.
The exact upstream Appendix B inventory label identified by the supplied precheck is included. The external precheck was not rerun here.
